name: validate
description: Run Evie enclosure hard gates (extents, manifold/no-float, fill band, named cutouts, cover hole pattern, design-mm only) and return a JSON report. Present passed + failed gate ids and artifact_id to the user for approve/revise.

part.description: Part to generate-and-validate when artifact_id is omitted.

artifact_id.description: Id returned by generate. If set, validate that solid.

mate_artifact_id.description: Optional faceplate artifact when validating cover hole/boss alignment.

inline_spec.description: Optional YAML/JSON spec (string, object, or path) used as the gate contract. Overrides the spec stored on the artifact.

token.description: Bot token. Default stub is local-dogfood (or COPILOTCAD_BOT_TOKEN).
